scope: Trace Z/Y/X interface semantics from raw voxels to frozen supervision; distinguish H1/H2/H3/H4.

affinity_pair_rule.symmetry_verdict: SYMMETRIC: affinity pair is always +1 along the affinity axis for all three axes (verified by tests/test_axis_semantics_geometry.py)

three_member_spread.rule: offsets ((0,0),(-1,0),(1,0)) applied to other[0],other[1] where other = axes != affinity axis
three_member_spread.documented_asymmetry: spread replicate direction = other[0] (first non-affinity axis): Z-affinity spreads along Y; Y-affinity spreads along Z; X-affinity spreads along Z
three_member_spread.impact: Does NOT change the biological pair judged (still +1 along affinity axis); only the location of the 2 replicate observations differs. Not a coordinate bug.

array_vs_world_order.channel_zyx_convention: 0=Z,1=Y,2=X consistently in workspace pair_contract, queue channel_zyx, reviewer, and materializer

napari_visualization.renders: raw EM in XY/XZ/YZ planes; A(left) and B(right=+1 along channel) marked; reviewer sees exactly pair_left_zyx and pair_right_zyx
napari_visualization.verdict: displayed voxels equal the recorded affinity pair for each channel_zyx

trace.interior_boundary_checks: identical per axis (interior margin applied symmetrically on all three axes)

voxel_resolution.verdict: ISOTROPIC. A one-voxel Z affinity spans the same 8 nm physical distance as Y or X. This is FIB-SEM, not anisotropic ssTEM (contrast: registry CREMI 40x4x4).

raw_edge_contrast_by_crop_label_blind.metric: mean |single-voxel intensity step| over the 3 axis edges at interior centers
raw_edge_contrast_by_crop_label_blind.finding: The crops carrying Y-DIFFERENT (C,E) are ~6-14x higher raw edge contrast than the all-Y-SAME crops. Crop identity, raw contrast, and Y-class are mutually confounded in the historical data.

hypothesis_assessment.H1_implementation_bug: NOT SUPPORTED. Affinity pair semantics are symmetric and coordinate-correct across Z/Y/X (tested). Only a benign replicate-spread-direction asymmetry exists.
hypothesis_assessment.H2_anisotropy: RULED OUT. Isotropic 8x8x8 nm; one-voxel step is physically identical on all axes.
hypothesis_assessment.H3_candidate_generation: PLAUSIBLE and PARTIALLY SUPPORTED. Historical selection used argmax(|gradient|) to ASSIGN each candidate to one axis, so Z/Y/X were never sampled at matched locations; and high-contrast (C/E) vs low-contrast crops were unevenly represented. This can manufacture an axis/class association.
hypothesis_assessment.H4_biological: NOT YET PROVEN. Cannot be separated from H3 + crop/contrast confound with historical data. Requires the paired-location, contrast-balanced experiment.
hypothesis_assessment.conclusion: No implementation bug or anisotropy. The Z=DIFFERENT / Y,X=SAME pattern is confounded with crop identity AND raw contrast AND per-axis selection. The axis-neutral paired-location experiment across balanced contrast strata is required to separate H3 from H4.
